libraries.name: @internationalized/date
libraries.note: All 386 tests passed. The suite runs once: CI tests React 16 to canary, not a range of Node versions. The 12 methods on the Calendar interface are counted once, not again on each of its 13 implementations.

libraries.name: Luxon
libraries.note: CI (.github/workflows/test.yml) runs `npm run test` on Node 20, 22, 24 and 25 under one fixed time zone, America/New_York, so executions are 1,222 × 4. The 46 local failures come from the machine: the suite assumes its CI container's local time zone is America/New_York. They do not change the test count. Luxon ships no types, so the API was counted from @types/luxon 3.7.6, which tracks 3.7.x.

libraries.name: date-fns
libraries.note: The suite runs the `main` Vitest project. CI (node_tests.yaml) runs it on Node 22, 24, 25 and 26, so that part is 3,167 × 4. A second workflow (tz_tests.yaml) runs the same 3,167 tests under all 378 time-zone settings of its own tool, so executions are 3,167 × 4 + 3,167 × 378 = 1,209,794. All 378 zones passed. The `temporarily` project is not run by CI and is not counted. `formatDate` is an alias of `format`, counted once. The 1 method is the function-typed member of the exported Localize type.

libraries.name: Moment.js
libraries.note: 0 tests failed on Node 24. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs `pnpm test` on three Node versions (lts/*, lts/-1, latest), so executions are 3,944 × 3. timezones.yml re-runs 5 test modules, not the full suite, under 6 zones; those partial runs are not counted. The repository holds 193 test files; `locales` counts the 140 of them that test a locale.

libraries.name: Day.js
libraries.note: A single default run is 93 suites and 794 tests. 793 pass and 1 fails: the failure is in the upstream code and also appears at the earlier commit, so it is counted under known failures. The repository's `test` script first re-runs test/timezone.test.js (6 tests) and test/plugin/timezone.test.js (54 tests) under 6 distinct TZ values (Pacific/Auckland, Europe/London, America/Whitehorse, the system default, Europe/Paris, America/New_York), then runs the full jest suite: 4 × 6 + 4 × 54 + 794 = 1,034 executions. `locales` counts test/locale.test.js plus the 41 files in test/locale/. CI runs `npm test` on a single Node LTS. The API count covers the core and the 37 plugins shipped in the same npm package; core alone is 4 functions and 30 methods. The commit is on the `dev` branch, where `package.json` carries the placeholder version `0.0.0-development`: its `src`, `test` and `types` trees are the same as those of the tag v1.11.23.

libraries.name: Spacetime
libraries.note: All 8,910 tests passed. CI runs Node 20, 22, 24, 25 and 26 (the suite has 8,697 tests on the four older versions and 8,910 on the newest), so executions are 4 × 8,697 + 8,910 = 43,698. `locales` counts the 6 locale test files. `timezones` counts the 22 dedicated time-zone and DST test files that run. The `spacetime/temporal` entry point is not counted in the API.
